question: What manifold classifications of the liṅga are indicated here?
premises: Multiple types are listed in sequence.
The types include self-born, divine, arrow, sage, and human forms.
inference: The liṅga is classified in many ways, including self-born, divine, bāṇa, sage, and human types.
uncertainties: The exact technical sense of bāṇa-liṅga depends on broader Śaiva usage.
plain_english: It is classified in many ways, such as self-born, divine, bāṇa, sage, human, and so on.
